_comment: hub-literal-census.js rules (R0 proof kit, 2026-10-21). classRuleList is FIRST MATCH WINS over the tree-relative path; a .js file reaching class 'source' is split into 'code' and 'comments' by where each occurrence sits. falsePositiveWordList: whole words (letter/digit/underscore runs) whose embedded token is not the hub's name, each measured. A token embedded mid-word in lower case (referencedStableId, DisplacedStudent) is not counted by rule, so only words that START with the token yet are not the hub need a row here.
